subject: planner: Skyline pruning to include equals within DNF (#62956)
summary: Reviewed diff vs parent with focus on `pkg/planner/core/find_best_task.go` skyline pruning. Change adds `candidatePath.hasOnlyEqualPredicatesInDNF()` and uses it to treat certain DNF-derived index ranges as “preferred” under `tidb_opt_prefer_range_scan` (mainly when stats are pseudo/missing), steering plan choice toward IndexLookUp/IndexReader for OR-of-equality patterns. Logic is confined to access-path pruning/selection and reuses ranger-produced `AccessConds`/`IsDNFCond`/`MinAccessCondsForDNFCond` (semantics checked via `pkg/util/ranger/detacher.go` and `pkg/planner/util/path.go`); no SQL correctness/transaction/session/privilege/visibility/protocol runtime Blocker/High issues found.
